import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

class OrderBuilder {
  private paid = false;
  private lines: number[] = [];
  withLine(price: number): this {
    this.lines.push(price);
    return this;
  }
  asPaid(): this {
    this.paid = true;
    return this;
  }
  build(): { paid: boolean; total: number } {
    return { paid: this.paid, total: this.lines.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0) };
  }
}
const anOrder = (): OrderBuilder => new OrderBuilder();

describe('an order', () => {
  describe('with lines', () => {
    describe('when it is paid', () => {
      it('is paid', () => {
        // given
        const order = anOrder().withLine(10).withLine(20).asPaid().build();
        // then
        expect(order.paid).toBe(true);
        expect(order.total).toBe(30);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('without lines', () => {
    it('costs nothing', () => {
      const order = anOrder().build();
      expect(order.total).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});
